tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the full Wraps documentation (CLI, TypeScript SDKs, infrastructure, guides) and return the matching sections as markdown. Use this first for any 'how do I ... with Wraps' question.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return the full markdown source of one Wraps page. Call list_docs first to see which paths have markdown.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Return the Wraps llms.txt index: every documentation page, product page, guide, and SDK reference with a one-line description.
